scripts.content:validate: tsx tools/syncApproved.ts && tsx tools/validateContent.ts && tsx tools/contentGuard.ts && tsx tools/contentAnchors.ts && tsx tools/contentAudit.ts && vitest run src/core/storyValidation.test.ts src/core/productionStoryValidation.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run content:validate && vite build
scripts.build:fixture: tsc --noEmit && npm run content:validate && vite build --mode fixture
scripts.acceptance: npm test && npm run build:fixture && playwright test && playwright test -c playwright.content.config.ts
scripts.acceptance:content: npm run build:fixture && playwright test -c playwright.content.config.ts
scripts.acceptance:prologue: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.prologue.config.ts
scripts.acceptance:review: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.review.config.ts
